# Chromium offline dino game (vendored)

These files come from the Chromium project (mirror: `github.com/chromium/chromium`), commit `644979367abdf38df19730eac6754da5871f867d` (2026-03-10).

## Files

Everything except `LICENSE` comes from `components/neterror/resources/` and keeps its path relative to that folder:

- `dino_game/*.ts`
- `images/default_100_percent/offline/100-offline-sprite.png`
- `images/default_200_percent/offline/200-offline-sprite.png`
- `sounds/*.mp3`
- `neterror.html`

`LICENSE` comes from the root of the repository.

## Changes

None. Every file is copied as-is.
